audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ziggs five of seven rows at 2/10 while the whys for those rows say 'it's a wash', 'Your full Q-W combo is online', 'You out-trade him at melee range', 'coinflip' and 'Iceborn lets you finally stick'. Separately, diff reads EVEN while diffRating is 8.5/10, the tone is the red hard-matchup colour and the final rating line says 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Skill / Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / K'Sante / Ziggs against a 49.91% win rate over 557 games. Ziggs has no escape besides Satchel Charge on 20s at rank 1, so once K'Sante reaches him at 3 the melee rows are his; Ziggs owns the artillery scaling.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 realigned to the packet, ratings adjusted, and diff set to HARD so it stops contradicting its own 8.5/10 and the tone colour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Ziggs ability was named and no cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at 850 range, Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000, Hexplosive Minefield 16s flat at 900, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s at 5000. The 850-vs-450 range gap is the whole early game and was never quantified.
audit.corrected: Ranges and cooldowns now appear in the whys, spikes, early and mid text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says twice to 'W-charge in unstoppable through his Satchel'. K'Sante's W is not unstoppable in the kit data, and Satchel Charge explicitly knocks enemies away. The 2-stack Ntofo shockwave was again called a knock-up, and Short Fuse's attack reset was absent.
audit.why: Riot's K'Sante W text: 'charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning'. Riot's Satchel Charge text: 'The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away' — plus it carries the percentHealth flag, so armour is not the answer to it. Riot's K'Sante Q: the 2-stack shockwave 'pulls enemies in'. Short Fuse carries the autoReset flag.
audit.corrected: The unstoppable claim is gone; Satchel Charge is now a 20s knock-away you bait rather than tank through; the shockwave pulls; Short Fuse's reset is named as the tell.

edits.before: Ziggs out-ranges everything you have at Levels 1-2, so don't try to walk through his Q bombs to last-hit — take the safe CS at the tip of your Q range and accept some chip. The lane turns at Level 3: once your Q-W combo is up, the second he steps forward to shove or land a Satchel, W-charge in unstoppable through it, Q3 to knock him up, and make him pay for the poke he was free-casting. He has zero escape if you actually reach him — the whole problem is reaching him.
edits.after: Ziggs out-ranges everything you have at Levels 1-2 — Bouncing Bomb is 850 to your 450 — so take the safe CS at the tip of your Q and accept some chip. The lane turns at Level 3: the second he steps forward to shove, W-charge in for the stun, then pull him with the 2-stack Ntofo and make him pay for the poke he was free-casting. Watch his auto wind-up too: Short Fuse is an attack reset. He has zero escape once you reach him — reaching him is the whole problem.

edits.before: This is your best stretch of lane. Bait his W Satchel — it's his only knockback to break your engage — then E over a wall or W-charge in and Q3 him; without it he can't peel your lockdown. At 6, All Out lets you dash through him and win the straight 1v1, but it converts your tank stats to duelist, so only ult when his Satchel and Flash are down or his burst will trade evenly. Iceborn Gauntlet is your real unlock: the slow on-hit finally lets you stick through his kite instead of watching him walk backward casting bombs.
edits.after: This is your best stretch of lane. Bait Satchel Charge — 20s at rank 1, and his only knockback to break your engage — then E over a wall or W-charge in and pull him; without it he cannot peel your lockdown. At 6, All Out lets you dash through him and win the straight 1v1, but it converts your tank stats to duelist, so ult only when Satchel and Flash are down. Iceborn Gauntlet is the real unlock: the slow finally lets you stick through his kite instead of watching him walk backward casting bombs.
